# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.5.0

Feature release focused on callback reliability, reverse-proxy friendliness,
French localization, and event replay cleanup.

## Highlights

- Adds a dedicated callback base URL override so the C300X agent can use a
  stable local Home Assistant HTTP endpoint while browser/external access keeps
  using HTTPS or a reverse proxy.
- Rejects unsuitable callback targets early, including HTTPS, `.local`,
  loopback, link-local, malformed ports, and other URLs the embedded agent
  cannot reliably call.
- Adds French Home Assistant translations and French C300X display labels.
- Suppresses replayed subscription snapshots so doorbell automations are not
  re-fired merely because Home Assistant restarted.
- Keeps HA doorbell video recoverable if a display/app media-close callback is
  missed.

## Security and Privacy

- Callback diagnostics classify URL shape and host type without exposing token
  values or private callback URLs.
- The native agent remains HTTP-only for local LAN callbacks. HTTPS remains the
  recommended frontend/browser path for external access and WebRTC microphone
  support.
- No firmware payloads, APKs, copied stock QML pages, third-party controller
  source trees, token values, or broker passwords are included.

## Notes

- For reverse-proxy setups, keep external/browser access on HTTPS, but configure
  the C300X callback path to a reachable local Home Assistant HTTP endpoint.
- Avoid `homeassistant.local`, link-local IPv6 addresses, and HTTPS for the
  embedded C300X agent callback path.
